notes: Clean lane: no new quantifiable exploit beyond the known ledger (security-MAJ-8-r1, security-MIN-7-r1, security-MIN-4-r2 cover the permissions surface). Not re-reported as variants: smine-permissions L45 derivation also yields Bash(git -C *) / Bash(go run *) from leading-option or code-runner tokens — same defect as security-MIN-4-r2; its fix should key the subcommand on the first non-option token, not a wrapper list. Cross-chunk suspicions for the station: (1) smine-apply step 7 validates only <kind>.json, never settings/claude_code/settings.json after the permissions-branch append — whether make audit or cmd/sync/sync_settings.sh rejects a malformed settings.json before it reaches ~/.claude is outside this chunk; (2) smine-orchestrate step 6 auto-pushes merged main, including sessions/ batch JSON with verbatim quotes, snippets and granted argv from every mined repo — exposure depends on origin visibility and the nightly wrapper (routines/, cmd/), outside this chunk. No scope removed: all 24 manifest files reviewed (relevance filter excluded none).
